title: 第 25 章 你敢接受挑战吗第 26 章 这怎么可能
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: “差不多了。”
大长老坐在高台上看着下面的弟子们，他的目光在人群中扫了一圈然后落在了陆云身上。
“陆云你上来吧。”
在陆云听到师父的话之后嘴角微微上扬，他整理了一下衣服然后大步走上了擂台。
站在擂台中央的陆云双手负在身后，只见他的脸上带着自信的笑容随后将目光扫过下方的弟子们。
“还有没有人要挑战的。”大长老开口说道。
“我徒儿陆云就站在这里，有谁愿意上来跟他比试比试。”
台下的弟子们面面相觑没有一个人敢说话，陆云金丹大圆满的修为在外门是公认的第一。
谁上去谁就是找打，这种明摆着吃亏的事没有傻子会干。
“怎么没有人敢上来吗。”大长老说道。
台下依然没有人说话，大长老的眉头皱了一下正准备开口的时候一个声音从人群中传了出来。
“我来。”
众人转过头看去只见一个身材魁梧的弟子从人群中走了出来，他的脸上带着不服气的表情。
“是赵青山，金丹期六层的修为在外门也算是排得上号的了。”
“金丹六层打金丹大圆满，这不是找死吗。”
“谁知道呢说不定人家想搏一把呢。”
台下的弟子们议论纷纷，赵青山没有理会那些闲言碎语大步走上了擂台。
“请陆师兄赐教。”赵青山抱拳道。
这时的陆云看了他一眼而眼中也闪过一丝不屑，一个金丹六层的废物也敢上台来挑战他。
“出手吧。”陆云淡淡道。
只见赵青山深吸一口气调动体内的真元，随后一股强大的气势从他身上扩散出来。
大喝一声以后便一掌朝陆云拍了过去，那掌风凌厉速度极快。
可陆云站在原地动都没动，等他的掌风快要击中他的时候才抬起手。
一掌拍出。
只见赵青山的身体直接倒飞了出去重重的摔在了擂台下面，紧接着噗的一声一口鲜血从他嘴里喷了出来。
而且他的左臂还以一个看起来都很疼的角度弯折着，就连骨头也断了。
“啊……”赵青山惨叫了连连声音都颤抖了起来。
台下的弟子们看到这一幕脸色都变了，仅仅只是一招一个金丹六层的弟子就这么被打残了。
“还有谁要上来吗。”陆云站在擂台上目光扫过下方。
没有人说话所有人的脸上都带着恐惧的表情。
毕竟金丹六层连一招都接不住，他们上去也是一样的下场。
“既然没人敢上来，那我就自己挑一个对手吧。”陆云说道。
目光在人群中扫了一圈然后落在了陈默身上，能注意到他嘴角微微上扬露出一丝冷笑。
“陈默你上来。”
台下的弟子们纷纷转过头看向陈默，他们的眼神里有同情也有几分幸灾乐祸。
“上次你侥幸赢了我一次，今天当着所有人的面你敢不敢再跟我打一场。”陆云说道。
“怎么不敢说话了吗，你不是挺厉害的吗。”
“上次打我妹妹抢她灵石的时候你怎么不怂，现在怎么不吭声了。”
但陈默站在原地没有说话，他的脸上没有什么表情。
“陈默你该不会是怕了吧。”陆云继续说道。
“你要是怕了也可以，跪下来给我磕三个头然后叫我一声爷爷我就饶了你。”
台下的弟子们发出一阵哄笑声，不少人都在看热闹。
高台之上大长老也开口了，他的声音不大却清清楚楚的传进了每个人的耳朵里。
“陈默，既然陆云点名要跟你比试那你就上来吧，在宗门大典上切磋比试是规矩你不会连这点规矩都不懂吧。”

"Almost."
The Great Elder sat on the high platform and looked at the disciples below. His eyes swept around the crowd and then landed on Lu Yun.
"Lu Yun, come up."
After Lu Yun heard his master's words, the corners of his mouth raised slightly. He straightened his clothes and strode onto the ring.
Lu Yun stood in the center of the ring with his hands behind his back. With a confident smile on his face, he glanced at the disciples below.
"Is there anyone else who wants to challenge?" the great elder said.
"My disciple Lu Yun is standing right here. Who is willing to come up and compete with him?"
The disciples in the audience looked at each other in shock and no one dared to speak. Lu Yun's golden elixir Dzogchen cultivation was recognized as the best among the outer sects.
Anyone who goes up is looking for a beating, and no fool would do something like this that would obviously result in a loss.
"Why doesn't anyone dare to come up?" the great elder said.
There was still no one in the audience speaking. The great elder frowned and was about to speak when a voice came from the crowd.
"I'll do it."
Everyone turned around and saw a burly disciple walking out of the crowd with an unconvinced expression on his face.
"It's Zhao Qingshan. His cultivation level at the sixth level of the Golden Core Stage is considered to be high in the outer sect."
"To achieve the Golden Elixir Dzogchen at the sixth level of the Golden Elixir, isn't this looking for death?"
"Who knows, maybe someone wants to give it a try."
The disciples in the audience were talking a lot, but Zhao Qingshan ignored the gossip and strode onto the ring.
"Please teach me, Senior Brother Lu." Zhao Qingshan cupped his fists and said.
At this time, Lu Yun glanced at him with a trace of disdain flashing in his eyes. A waste of the sixth level of Jindan dared to come on stage to challenge him.
"Let's take action." Lu Yun said calmly.
Zhao Qingshan took a deep breath to mobilize the true energy in his body, and then a powerful aura spread out from his body.
After shouting loudly, he slapped Lu Yun with a palm, and the palm wind was fierce and very fast.
But Lu Yun stood there without moving, and only raised his hand when the wind from his palm was about to hit him.
Clap it with one palm.
I saw Zhao Qingshan's body flying backwards and falling heavily under the ring, and then a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth with a pop.
Moreover, his left arm was bent at an angle that looked painful, and even the bones were broken.
"Ah..." Zhao Qingshan screamed and his voice trembled.
The expressions of the disciples in the audience changed when they saw this scene. With just one move, a disciple at the sixth level of the Golden Core was crippled.
"Is there anyone else coming up?" Lu Yun stood on the ring and glanced below.
No one spoke and everyone had a look of fear on their faces.
After all, the sixth level of Jindan couldn't even catch a single move, so they would end up with the same fate if they went up.
"Since no one dares to come up, then I will choose an opponent myself." Lu Yun said.
His eyes swept around the crowd and then landed on Chen Mo. He could notice that the corners of his mouth were slightly raised with a sneer.
"Chen Mo, come up."
The disciples in the audience turned to look at Chen Mo, with sympathy and a bit of schadenfreude in their eyes.
"You were lucky enough to win against me last time. Do you dare to fight me again in front of everyone today?" Lu Yun said.
"Why don't you dare to speak? Aren't you very powerful?"
"Why didn't you give up when you beat my sister to steal her spiritual stone last time? Why don't you say anything now?"
But Chen Mo stood there without speaking, with no expression on his face.
"Chen Mo, are you afraid?" Lu Yun continued.
"If you're scared, just kneel down and kowtow three times and call me grandpa and I'll spare you."
The disciples in the audience burst into laughter, and many people were watching the excitement.
The Great Elder on the high platform also spoke, his voice was not loud but it reached everyone's ears clearly.
"Chen Mo, since Lu Yun has named you and wants to compete with you, then come up. It's a rule to compete in a sect ceremony. You don't even understand this rule?"
